title: Mixed Event — A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?! — Episode7 A Finale Full of Smiles

meta.Event: A Gentleman Thief's Thrilling White Day?!
meta.Episode: Episode7 — A Finale Full of Smiles
meta.Event Outline: Not long before White Day, Tsukasa is set to perform as an extra at a facility where visitors can make their own chocolates. Meanwhile, Mizuki has come up with plans for White Day return gifts, and invites Akito along for some chocolate making.

rows.Line: Chocolate Factory

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Alright, the chocolates have finally cooled. Now for decorations!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
“Yeah!
How do you want to decorate them, Mr. Thief?”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Hmm... These chocolates will need to look so gorgeous that our crybaby friend won't have any choice but to turn his frown upside down!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
“Yeah, that'd be awesome!
We can make them all shiny and sparkly♪”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(Looks like everyone's having fun!
But...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
(Our chocolates will be done soon...
Which also means...)

rows.Speaker: Adults
rows.Line: Hm? If Chocota's chocolates are done, doesn't that mean ours should be ready too?

rows.Speaker: Adults
rows.Line: These special refrigerators are supposed to help dry everything we made faster, right?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (This show was only meant to last as long as the chocolate-making demonstration. Some of them must already be sensing that something is up...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I'd say we have five minutes at most...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (Maybe it's too late for Hamano to reappear...)

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: (I still don't know what happened, but I want to at least give Hamano a satisfactory ending...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
...
Hey!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Tsukasa!
I think Li'l Bro's giving us the signal!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What...?!
Does that mean Hamano's ready...?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Alright, let's regroup and get ready for the finale!

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Just sprinkle on a few more of these sparkly bits... Slowly... Little by little and... Done!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Now to hand what we've made to Chocota...”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's your signal. Ready?

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Yes...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
“Hey!
Chocota says he's all better now!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “I'm back, everyone!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line:
Huh?
Hey, it's him!

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“Sorry for causing such a fuss earlier!
I really didn't mean to surprise you like that, Choco Maniac...”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Yes, you really had me going there!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“But you seem much better now!
I'd expect no less from my respected rival!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Hehe. Luckily, I had my friend over there to help cheer me up!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“That's great to hear!
Thank you, we appreciate what you've done!”

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
“You're welcome...!
It didn't seem right to see Chocota crying like that!”

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
“Anyway, Mr. Thief...!
I believe it's time to present Chocota with his gift♪”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “What?”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Yes, that's right!
Here... This is for you!!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “For me?! But you're the Choco Maniac. I thought you only stole chocolate from people. You really made these for me...?!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Because you were crying!
Honestly, we were worried sick about you.”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “So, we all worked together to make these, including the little ones. They were just as concerned about you.”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Choco Maniac... All of you...”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “The truth is, a close friend with whom I've been exchanging Valentine's Day gifts will be moving away soon...”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “I was reminded of that earlier and was overwhelmed with sadness. However...”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “The chocolates you all made with the Choco Maniac have helped put a smile back on my face! Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “I don't like having to say goodbye to such a close friend, but it's great to know that I'll have plenty of opportunities in the future to meet new friends, like you!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “Chocota...”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “But your friend won't be gone forever. You'll always have a connection to each other...”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “So you should keep exchanging gifts!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“You're right...!
Thanks, Choco Maniac!”

rows.Speaker: Girl
rows.Line: That's great, Chocota!

rows.Speaker: Boy
rows.Line: Make sure to eat lots and lots of the chocolates we made for you, okay?!

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“And there you have it..!
Because of all of you, I know how joyous it is to give someone else chocolates! Thank you!”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line: “I vow to no longer steal anyone's chocolates, and become Choco Maniac the great chocolatier!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line:
“What?!
Well, someone's in a good mood... Hehe.”

rows.Speaker: Choco Maniac
rows.Line:
“Hah hah hah!!
We shall meet again when you come back to make chocolates! Until then, farewell!”

rows.Speaker: Chocota
rows.Line: “Bye!”

rows.Speaker: Children
rows.Line: “Bye bye!!”

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
(They're all smiles...!
Great job, Tsukasa!)
Green Room

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa, Akito & Mizuki
rows.Line: We did it...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Ad-libbing for that long during the show is quite an accomplishment if I do say so myself...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
No kidding...
I'd be tripping over what to say even for just one line.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Haha. Really?
Okay, to be fair, I wasn't sure what was gonna happen either. I have to tip my hat to all the improv actors out there...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: You guys...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hamano!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: I'm so sorry about what happened today. This show would've gone so much smoother if it weren't for me...

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
But you were all willing to help.
You made this show a fun and happy occasion for all. How do I even begin to thank you?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
There's no need for that!
After all, you gave us the smile we were hoping to see in the end! I couldn't be happier as a future star!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line: Future star?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Yes! My name is Tsukasa Tenma, the bright star of the future! Behold my acting prowess!

rows.Speaker: Hamano
rows.Line:
I won't forget your name!
I'm sure you'll achieve your dream!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: As for you two... Thank you for jumping in to help us like that. We really appreciate what you did today!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There was no way we could've sent everyone home smiling without you both, so bravo!

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line:
Everyone!
The chocolates are all finished!

rows.Speaker: Staff's Voice
rows.Line: We'll be handing them out one at a time, so we ask you to please be patient while we do!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Hey, the chocolates are done!
We should make sure to go get some later.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah. Let's give everyone else a chance to get theirs first before we go...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Hm? That must be the staff.
Come in...!

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Excuse me...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Shiho?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What are you doing here?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I came here with a friend today to make chocolates for White Day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: You're here with a friend?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Hey, Haruka!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hello. Pardon the intrusion.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh, we met at the shrine...!
Hold on, does this mean you were both among the audience today?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Thank you for seeing our show today!
Are you here to greet all the cast members?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We wanted to give you a little gift for all your hard work today... Okay, by “we”, I really mean Kiritani...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: A gift?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, Hinomori and I had made some extra chocolates... Here.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Whoa! These are so cute!
They made us a bunch of rabbits and penguins♪

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, they look good...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Oh wow...!
These are magnificent...!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, I know! Sit tight for just one sec!
Lemme get my chocolates so we can all trade!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Alright, I'll go get mine too...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
What?!
W-Wait, I don't have anything to give...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I think you've given plenty already, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
She's right.
You gave us a wonderful show that put a smile on everybody's faces today.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, here we are...
Nice work today, Tsukasa.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Yeah, you were awesome out there!
Here's a little something from me!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I... I don't know what to say...!
I feel so blessed to have such wonderful juniors...!
*Sob*

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: What?! Now you're gonna cry?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa's Voice
rows.Line:
Waahhh!
Why are homemade chocolates so heartwarming?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: (Hehe. There really is something special about homemade chocolates... Oh, wait!)
